_comment: Benchmark scenes shared by test/reference/bench.mjs (Spark) and splattest --bench (native).
Each run first replays poses 0..warmup-1 (wrapping modulo frames) unmeasured, then measures
poses i = 0..frames-1. Orbit pose for pose i:
position = center + (radius * sin(a), height, radius * cos(a))
orientation = three.js lookAt(center): camera -Z toward the center, up +Y
Camera: perspective, vertical fov 60 degrees, near 0.01, far 1000, aspect width / height.
Scenes whose file is missing from build/fixtures are skipped (optional: true).
